name: Home lab with SAN, compute rack, and bespoke home network

mentions.name: Home lab with SAN, compute rack, and bespoke home network
mentions.description: This project builds a personal home lab, piecing together a SAN and compute nodes from old spare parts and second-hand servers in a newly assembled rack, along with a bespoke home network set up in place of ISP-provided equipment. AI assistance is used to make system customization easier.
mentions.problem: The builder's needs and preferences have outgrown commodity systems and default setups, compounded by a long-standing aversion to configuration and customization.
mentions.source_excerpt: Personal project - long past due to set up a home lab so I'm piecing together a SAN and some compute from old parts i have laying around and some second hand servers in a new rack I put together, along with setting up a bespoke home network instead of just using ISP stuff.
mentions.author: rjbwork
